progression.narrative: The performance opens on Fs3 and dwells most on Fs in Phrase 1. Phrase 3 (0:55.3) introduces Gk, B, C, Cs, centred on Ak. Phrase 4 (1:22.0) introduces Ab, Bk, centred on Ak. Phrase 5 (2:08.7) introduces Ek, centred on Ek. Phrase 6 (2:26.1) introduces Eb, F, Ck, Dk, centred on Ek. The line peaks at Ek5 (650.3 Hz) at 2:13.7. It closes on Dk4, not the tonic (C#4 → Ck4 → Ck4 → Ck4 → C4 → Dk4).
